title: EV Charging Program Terms for Parking License Holders
content:
EV charging on a Parking License is billed only while the license is active or notice-given.

## Terms

1. **Status.** The status on the license record decides: energy is billed while the license is active or notice-given. A suspended, waitlisted, withdrawn or terminated license is not billed for charging.
2. **Dedicated charger.** On an EV Charging Reserved Space, the dedicated charger bills energy at the product's on-peak rate for energy delivered from 07:00 to 21:00 local time and at the product's off-peak rate otherwise, one line per rate period of the session.
3. **Shared chargers.** Any other licensee may use the community's shared chargers at the product's shared-charger rate, with no time-of-use split, for at most the product's maximum hours per session.
4. **Rounding.** Energy amounts are rounded half up to the cent per line.

## Illustration (hypothetical rates, not the product's figures)

Take hypothetical rates of $0.30 per kWh on-peak and $0.20 per kWh off-peak. A dedicated-charger session that delivers 6.5 kWh between 19:00 and 21:00 and 20.25 kWh after 21:00 produces two lines:

| Line | Energy | Rate | Calculation in words | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| On-peak | 6.5 kWh | $0.30 | 6.5 multiplied by 0.30 | $1.95 |
| Off-peak | 20.25 kWh | $0.20 | 20.25 multiplied by 0.20 | $4.05 |

At a shared charger the same 26.75 kWh would be one line at the single shared-charger rate, with no split.

## Retired clause

*Retired:* "When a vehicle stays plugged in more than the product's idle grace minutes after charging completes, an idle fee of the product's idle fee per hour per started hour after the grace period is billed as a separate line; idle fees apply to shared and dedicated chargers alike." This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current idle fee schedule.

superseded_clauses: When a vehicle stays plugged in more than ev_idle_grace_minutes after charging completes, an idle fee of ev_idle_fee_per_hour per started hour after the grace period is billed as a separate line; idle fees apply to shared and dedicated chargers alike.
